title: Immediate Metabolic Response to LPS in Monocytes
author: Brandt D Pence
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ufcetiw
materials: Aspirate Cell-Tak solution if not already done.
While plate is incubating, perform steps 9-12.

steps.title: Warm XFp Analyzer and Hydrate Cartridge
steps.instruction: Turn on the Seahorse XFp analyzer and let it warm up overnight. Hydrate the sensor cartridge by adding 200 µl XF calibration solution to each well and 400 µl sterile PBS or H₂O to each moat, then incubate the cartridge overnight at 37 °C in a non‑CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Prepare Seahorse Assay Medium
steps.instruction: To 5 ml Seahorse Base Medium add 50 µl pyruvate, 50 µl L‑glutamine, and 20 µl glucose; sterile‑filter the complete medium before use.

steps.title: Coat Plate with Cell‑Tak
steps.instruction: Prepare a Cell‑Tak coating solution in 0.1 M sodium bicarbonate containing sodium hydroxide so that each well receives 0.56 µg Cell‑Tak and a final NaOH concentration of 0.63 mM. Add 25 µl of this solution to each well of the XFp plate. Incubate the plate at room temperature for at least 20 minutes (or longer); the plate may be stored at room temperature for a few hours, or pre‑coated, aspirated, air‑dried and stored at 4 °C until use.

steps.title: Prepare Monocyte Suspension
steps.instruction: Isolate monocytes according to the monocyte isolation protocol, then dilute them to 3 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹ in the prepared Seahorse DMEM assay medium. Keep the suspension on ice and use the cells immediately.

steps.title: Seed Cells and Media into Plate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl assay medium to wells A and H. Add 50 µl monocyte suspension to wells B‑G, delivering 1.5 × 10⁵ cells per well. Run samples in duplicate or triplicate as desired.

steps.title: Centrifuge Plate to Adhere Cells
steps.instruction: Place the plate in its carrier and centrifuge at 300 × g for 1 minute without brake.

steps.title: Add Assay Medium to Reach Final Volume
steps.instruction: Add 130 µl assay medium to each well (A‑H) so that the final well volume is 180 µl.

steps.title: Incubate Plate Before Assay
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C in a non‑CO₂ incubator for 1 hour.

steps.title: Prepare LPS Working Dilution
steps.instruction: Thaw a 1 µg ml⁻¹ LPS stock solution. Dilute 30 µl of this stock into 270 µl assay medium to obtain a 100 ng ml⁻¹ LPS working solution.

steps.title: Load and De‑bubble Sensor Cartridge
steps.instruction: Remove the hydrated sensor cartridge from the incubator and briefly re‑insert the sensors to clear any air bubbles.

steps.title: Add Injection Solutions to Cartridge Ports
steps.instruction: Load Port A of the cartridge: add 20 µl assay medium to wells A‑D and H (media control) and add 20 µl LPS working solution to wells E‑G, giving a final LPS concentration of 10 ng ml⁻¹ in those wells.

steps.title: Configure Seahorse XFp Assay Program
steps.instruction: Calibrate the sensor cartridge (remove lid), then set the assay program: basal measurement block of 5 reads followed by Injection 1 block of 23 reads.

steps.title: Run Seahorse Metabolic Assay
steps.instruction: Insert the cell plate into the XFp instrument and start the assay according to the programmed protocol.

steps.title: Post‑Assay Imaging or Protein Collection
steps.instruction: After the run, image each well by photomicroscopy or collect and isolate protein from each well for normalization of cell numbers.
